detail.title: WAKE Research Update: Complexity Emergence and Autonomous Goal Discovery
detail.summary: WAKE continues exploration of autonomous goal discovery mechanisms and complexity emergence. Project-unassigned-objective-exploration is proceeding with literature collection, while project-unprompted-complexity-emergence is preparing for hypothesis-driven experimental design, using collected sources to refine understanding of emergent structures.
